message.content: I don't know exactly how the nodules were discovered - just that they were found on examination. As for symptoms, I've noticed some mild pigmentation on my finger joints and knees, but I haven't had fever, night sweats, or cough. I was hospitalized about five years ago for a chest opacity, but no TB diagnosis was made. I'm not on glucocorticoids and don't have any family history of hereditary diseases.
